No. 24017/72/2017-IPR-I.-The President of India is pleased to make the following appointments to the posts of Technical Members in Intellectual Property Appellate Board, Chennai, for a period of 4 years from date of appointment or attaining the age of 65 years, or until further orders, whichever is earliest: SI. No. Name Technical Member Date of Appointment 1 Shri Birendra Prasad Singh Patents 21.08.2020 (Forenoon) 2 Ms Lakshmidevi Somanath Trade Marks 21.08.2020 (Forenoon) 3 Shri M Vijay Kumar Trade Marks 09.09.2020 (Forenoon) 4 Shri N Surya Senthil Copyrights 21.08.2020 (Forenoon) 5 Shri S P Chockalingam Copyrights 21.08.2020 (Forenoon) 2. The salaries and allowances payable to the above officials and the terms and conditions of the service by which they shall be governed, shall be in accordance with the Tribunal, Appellate Tribunal and other Authorities (Qualifications, Experience and other Conditions of Service of Members) Rules, 2020 notified on 12.02.2020. SACHIN DHAN!A, Dy. Secy.
